newsitem.title: FRANCE: French customs seize immigrants in octopus truck.
newsitem.headline: French customs seize immigrants in octopus truck.

text.p: French customs officers, checking trucks for British beef banned over the mad cow crisis, on Wednesday made a surprise haul of six illegal immigrants in a lorry carrying frozen squid and octopus.

The six foreigners, apparently from North Africa, were found crammed in a sleeping compartment in the truck, carrying seafood from Spain to Italy. They were caught near the Italian frontier by Nice customs.
Customs officials said the driver had admitted accepting cash from the immigrants to help them reach Italy.

A total of 109,000 refrigerator trucks have been checked in France by customs officials under a worldwide ban on British beef imposed in March because of fears that mad cow disease, most widespread in Britain, could be passed to humans.
